articleTitle: Big data in modern higher education. Benefits and criticism
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Big Data technology is very efficient in some cases, however, it has some disadvantages. It should be applied to modern universities which current quality of education is high enough. Thus the universities have to satisfy several conditions, for example, providing broad sets of different type tasks, including group discussions, oral speeches, essays with more than one possible correct opinion, developing complex skills of their students; collecting information about courses, student's activities and progress, alumni skills. Undoubtedly, Big Data are not the only opportunity to develop quality of education. Many small universities provide private educational programs for small groups. Moreover, they offer their students more direct conversations with lecturers in words of mouth format. This educational strategy definitely has its own advantages. Usage of Big Data in Russia is possible, however, it claims increasing of higher education quality.

articleTitle: Integration of quality management and digital technologies
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Development of science and technologies dictates need for development of new methods of management of quality. Along with already available methods and the systems of quality management new approaches appear. Some directions of improvement existing and creations of new tools, methods and the systems of quality management taking into account development of digital (information) technologies are shown in article.

articleTitle: DSS design for risk management of projects
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A set of mathematical models describing known risks of projects being implemented, which is used as a basis for risk classification in the design of DSS; in the implementation of risk management by DSS, it is proposed to use a package of formalized models of risk situations and information sources; the purposes, objectives and stages of designing the DSS for risk management of the projects being implemented.

articleTitle: Review of modern DDoS-attacks, methods and means of counteraction
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The current state of the problem of distributed attacks aimed at denial of service is investigated, the last DDoS attacks are monitored. The most popular type of DDoS attacks continues to be httpflood. The modern methods of diagnosing DDoS-attacks are investigated. Positive and negative aspects of these methods were identified.

articleTitle: Region-specific determiners of marine transport system development as basis for strategic focus formation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The analysis of transport indicators of the region is carried out. The structure of the model is given. An algorithm of iterative parameters is described. General conclusions and suggestions are made. They make it possible to outline the prospects of the innovative growth by the relevant directions (power and transport complexes, social sphere, tourism and recreation, agriculture). In order to forecast the level of the regional innovative development under the conditions of lacking the statistic data and to validate the key directions for the economic politics in the innovative sphere as well as to find the quantity parameters which changing allows achieving the outlined results, the economic and mathematical simulation was made.

articleTitle: Improvement of processes of quality management
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Development of science and technologies dictates need for development of new methods of management of quality. Along with already available methods and the systems of quality management new approaches appear. Some directions of improvement existing and creations of new tools, methods and the systems of quality management are shown in article.

articleTitle: Design process of software quality management
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The approach for the description, control and management of the quality indicators of the software development project is proposed. The approach is based on the presentation of quality indicators using fuzzy situations equation. The system of requirements to the composition of software quality characteristics is formed. The composition and structure of the automated situational system with fuzzy logic for the implementation of the software development project is proposed.

articleTitle: Automation of data defence processes in the corporation information systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: As a rule, large modern enterprises use not only one but several information systems: APCS, CAD/CAM/CAE, SCADA. These systems create the complex environment of interacting structures which include storage, processing, translation confidential information modules. The goal is to integrate and automate the processes of information defence in the systems with minimal impact on their productivity.

articleTitle: Development of a mathematical model of the control beginning of DDoS-attacks and malicious traffic
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A technique and algorithms for early detection of the started attack and subsequent blocking of malicious traffic are proposed. The primary separation of mixed traffic into trustworthy and malicious traffic was carried out using cluster analysis. Classification of newly arrived requests was done using different classifiers with the help of received training samples and developed success criteria.

articleTitle: Analysis of approaches to the construction of intrusion detection systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Modern approaches to the creation of expert systems were considered. Also, the main prospects for the development of expert systems that work on the basis of neural networks were considered.

articleTitle: Smart education in high school: New perspectives in global world
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper considers modern trends in the development of smart education in Europe and Asia. Various approaches to the management of smart education in universities are discussed. The specifics of the competence approach's application and distance formation of the training policy at Universities are analyzed. The case of the use of the distance education program in smart education is given based on one of the European universities.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the state and prospects of the development of next generation robotic surgery complexes
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Based on the results of performed work, and also on the basis of statistical analysis and analysis of the development of medical and robotic technologies during last decades, article considers possibility of creating a new generation assisting mechatronic robot-surgical complex based on fundamentally new architecture. Here is presented a work of interdisciplinary engineers and doctors team, are discussed the main problems of existed complexes and main advantages of the created experimental model of such complex.

articleTitle: The conception of surface quality formation for metal detail's shaping through layered growing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the feasibility to use an anodic machining for improving the surface quality of parts are produced by direct laser sintering from metal powders. The impact of the process combination allows to provide the required quality of the items in the combined machining method. In this method surface machining the achievement of quality achieves through the joint action of the cutting tool and the anodic dissolution of metal under the influence of an electric current in an electrolyte solution. Application of this method allows to obtain the processing of fusible metals and alloys of higher surface quality than conventional processing method.

articleTitle: Digital regulatory tools for entrepreneurial and creative behavior in the knowledge economy
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper provides conceptual analysis of creative and entrepreneurial behavior in digital economy. Despite recent advances in statistical inference, the casual interpretation of models that try to predict behavior based on observational data can be dangerous. Causal interpretation can result in reproducing and amplifying unwanted social phenomena e.g. stigmatization. Thus, the information security systems shall be built on the basis of experimental analysis of human behavior, ethical considerations, and take into account the further long-term outcomes from the regulatory tools within the automated digital environment and smart spaces.

articleTitle: The pediatric robotic-assisted rehabilitation complex for children and adolescents with cerebral palsy: Background and product design
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Cerebral palsy (CP) is the most common children and adults movement disorder that is associated with life-long disability and multiple impairments. Children with CP demonstrate poor fine and gross motor function due to psychomotor disturbances. Early rehabilitation programs are essential for children with CP and should be appropriate for the age and functional condition of the patients. Robot-assisted training (RAT) is a widespread approach for locomotion rehabilitation but the existing devices have a number of disadvantages. The aim of the study was the development of the design of an innovative robotic-assisted complex for the rehabilitation of children and adolescents with cerebral palsy. Medical data from 75 case-records of patients with CP (age 2-14) that underwent RAT using the existing devices (COBS Feedback and/or MOTOmed) were copied. Age, CP form, rehabilitation method, Gross Motor Function Classification System, modify Ashworth scale, Medical Research Council Paralysis Scale assessment before and after the rehabilitation course were included. All received information was added to an electronic database for storage and subsequent processing. A number of disadvantages of the existing RAT devices were found and medical and engineering needs and characteristics for proposed rehabilitation complex were listed. The innovative pediatric robotic-assisted complex will be an advanced technical solution for rehabilitation of CP and will allow improve psychomotor functions, dynamic activities, the quality of life and the social adaptation opportunities of CP patients.

articleTitle: Social engineering and digital technologies for the security of the social capital' development
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Social capital is transformed due to the digitalized environment built with the ICT expansion. The evolution of the social capital' forming and development reflects the new forms and models of communication, the extended possibilities of choice and of presence into the Web as a unique space of exchange. This article presents the theoretical approach to the analysis of behavior' regulation within the framework of social technologies implemented to the digital space. Social engineering represents an important factor of the violation of information security' rules, the IT-specialists attribute the majority of the crime in the sector to the insiders of private business companies and to the imprudence of individuals. The social capital can play the both positive and negative roles to assure information security issues, the social engineering can be in the contradiction with the tendencies of the social capital development, but the social technologies used are based on the social capital development.

articleTitle: Analysis automation of the software user interfaces
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers the architecture of an information system for automating the testing of user interfaces based on the use of Internet technologies. The general description of the system operation, the description of the main modules, the structure of the interface of the Internet resource are given.

Author Keywords: information system for automating the testing
testing based on the Internet technologies

articleTitle: Quality management in IT service management based on statistical aggregation and decomposition approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The task of minimizing the costs of providing IT services, as a task of optimizing control actions on quality indicators, was solved. An Statistical Aggregation and Decomposition approach was developed to study the quality of IT services on the basis of multiple regression and autoregression of the integrated moving average, in which these methods were jointly used to predict the components of the aggregated quality indicator.

articleTitle: Intelligent components to support workflow in the design and production activities
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Software and methodological tools of building and conversions of an information object describing a complex of project and production operations on creation of the complex technical system are considered. Information is ordered on the basis of design or technological dividing of an object of production according to the developed model of the combined workflow describing causes and effect relationships between processes on stages of a life cycle of creation of a product. For increase in efficiency of the process of formation of the combined workflow of operations design-technology and project and production knowledge bases are used. Examples of application of intellectual components of support of the combined workflow of operations for the system realizing a method of project and operational control of the machine-building enterprise are given.

articleTitle: Analysis of risk management in innovation activity process
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The importance of enterprise innovation risk management is constantly increasing, because it has influence on the company's leading positions, increasing its competitiveness in the domestic and international markets. It also helps to increase the economic and production potentials that are necessary to implement the innovative development strategy of the state as a whole. There are certain problems in the field of innovation management. At present time, there is no unified assessment methodology of risk impact of the enterprise innovation activity. Each enterprise uses independently developed methods for calculating the risk based on the ratio of risk costs to the risk time. It leads to errors in the valuation of identified risks and their negative outcomes and, as a result, in this situation the risk management effectiveness is reduced. The authors of the article propose a classification of the main types of risks in an innovation project. On the basis of the proposed classifications, an innovation risk management model for enterprise has been developed.

Author Keywords: classification of risks in an innovation project

articleTitle: Models to support design of highly reliable distributed computer systems with redundant processes of data transmission and handling
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In today's economic conditions, engineers are faced with the problem of designing complex distributed computer systems under tight deadlines. Ensuring high reliability and robustness of such systems requires redundancy of their structure as well as the processes of data transmission and handling. The purpose of this study is to create simulation models and means to support computer-aided design of highly reliable distributed computer systems. The simulation environment is AnyLogic 7, used in conjunction with Microsoft SQL Server 2008. The developed models and means are aimed at the optimization of design solutions to the arrangement of the processes of redundant multipath distribution of copies of requests and their redundant handling by clustered servers, interconnected through the given network, under conditions of failures, transmission errors, losses of requests, and limitations on the acceptable residence time of requests in the system. The possibilities of the proposed means for design support, for example choosing the optimal redundancy order of data transmission and processing, are presented. The scope of the efficient use of redundant distribution and handling of requests is determined.

articleTitle: Methods and tools of project-operational management of a machine-building enterprise
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Principles of creation and main mechanisms of implementation of a method of project and operational management for machine-building enterprises are considered. The method uses the model of the combined workflow determining causes and effect relationships between processes at stages of a lifecycle of creation of the complex technical system. All processes connected to development and manufacture are considered in the uniform project and production environment in which the process of creation of a product is implemented. The target function of the system created on the basis of a method is reduction of a cycle of creation of new products and minimization of project and production losses.

articleTitle: Innovation risk minimization and neutralization methods
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The study of minimization and neutralization ways of risks is associated with the need to identify more effective ways to manage the enterprise's innovation as an effective process of creating a supportive economic and production environment of the organization. It should ensure the entry of companies into the international innovation market. Innovation risks are explored in the context of different conceptual approaches, which become a causes of different characteristics of the economic risk, the absence of their unified classification, which helps to determine the risk specificity, to identify their diversity, properties, relationships and dependencies, and thereby use a more efficient method of risk management. According to the innovation management analysis the authors presented an integrated approach to innovation risk management which is based on more effective ways of their minimization and neutralization. The new mechanisms of risk minimization, additional resources in the innovation sphere, and solution of innovative risk management problems are very relevant and timely.

articleTitle: Problems of information security technology the “Internet of Things”
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the article the questions of application of the so-called technology of “Internet of things”. Analysis of the content and prospects of the development. Systematized and generalized information security of this technology, feasible solutions to existing problems. Detailed considered the triad of information security - confidentiality, integrity, availability.

articleTitle: Analysis of hierarchical structure of the corporate network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The possibilities of the analysis of structure of the corporate network structure based on the preliminary analysis of its information structure are shown. Methods of the description of hierarchical structure of the network and computation of its characteristics are offered.

articleTitle: E-learning technologies in Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper is dedicated to the development of modern education technologies in distinct regions on the example of Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug. The author showed that students in this region are underprivileged besides the level of average income and salary because of a lack of ordinary higher education programs and low Internet quality. The development of e-learning opportunities can increase quality of education in the region. It has to include four aspects: developing and improving communication technologies, improving of knowledge of foreign languages; developing of distant higher education, especially programs in technical and technological fields. E-learning technologies in Russia have to provide an association with a particular group of people as ordinary higher education does.

articleTitle: Improvement of the quality of calculations using the Monte Carlo simulation method in the evaluation of mining investment projects
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Objectives. The article proposes a modification of the method for quantitative risk assessment (the Monte Carlo simulation method) by taking into account the multifactorial relationship between the key parameters and the risk factors of the investment project, which makes it possible to obtain a more relevant and efficient sample of simulations. Methods. Investigations described in the article are based on statistic and other kind of information of russian gold mining company called Polymetal Ltd. Findings/Improvements. At the moment, the culture of risk management is poorly developed at domestic enterprises, in particular, the risk assessment of new investment projects often boils down to only a small standard classification and identification of some risks and an analysis of the sensitivity of the net present project income to a change in some key indicators. Since the change in parameters occurs without taking into account the objectively existing relationships between them (both in sensitivity analysis and in simulation analysis), the result is biased. Therefore, after doing several thousand iterations, you can get the necessary number of different scenarios with changed key parameters with predefined probability distributions. Further, having constructed a matrix or a scheme of key parameters, it is necessary to determine the relationships between these parameters (based on expert experience, statistical data or from the NPV model), the relationships between the parameters are determined. After that, those scenarios are excluded from the sample, the key parameters of which do not correspond to certain dependencies among themselves. Thus, we increase the objectivity of imitation scenarios of the NPV investment project. Application: The investigation results can be used by Russian mining companies to improve the quality of risk managing in mining projects.

articleTitle: Innovation management characteristics of industrial enterprises
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Innovation risks are a complex multifaceted concept. In order to work successfully in a risky environment, organizations' employees need deep and comprehensive economic knowledge. Innovation risk assessing and determining their impact degree on the economic situation of enterprises is a complex multifunctional process. Existing risk minimization matrices do not provide an opportunity to identify the most dangerous risks in order to make quick effective management decisions. There is no integrated algorithm for the process of identification and risk management, which helps to minimize and neutralize the innovation risks of enterprises. Innovation management characteristics of enterprise are shown in the article. An algorithm of risk assessing during the innovation project work is presented. The innovation management ways, taking into account risks, are analyzed.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of incident management in the composite applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, the tasks of ensuring the quality and stability of the provided IT services are extremely topical. In the operation of the composite applications, the problem of increasing the effectiveness of incident management is a complex technical problem, the solution of which requires the use of the simulation methods. In the work, the integration platform Ensemble of InterSystems Company was considered as a basis for designing integration solutions. Given the architectural features of the integration platforms, a mathematical model of the incident management process in the Ensemble integration platform is proposed. This mathematical model was used to develop algorithms for identifying and classifying incidents. The results of the work can be used in the design and development of incident management information systems, as well as in organizing the work of technical support services for IT companies.

articleTitle: Virtual simulation method of interrelated physical processes in on-board electronic means
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Virtual simulation method is developed in the work. It based on virtual 3D-models of the structures of on-board electronic means designs with superimposed heterogeneous fields of electrical, thermal, mechanical and other processes caused by united impacts of external factors. A distinctive feature of this method is the account of the close relationship of the flowing physical processes between themselves during the simulation.

articleTitle: Quality assurance of engineering degree programs through public professional accreditation: Practical experience
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper gives a brief presentation of organizational and methodical peculiarities of university degree programs public professional accreditation as affective mechanism for quality assurance in engineering education in Russia, USA, Canada, and EU countries.

articleTitle: Determination of the pressure between the wheel of the moving railcar and rails subject to the defects
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the modeling of the behavior of railway tracks under a dynamic load of wheel set taking into account the elastic, viscous-elastic and elastic-plastic properties of the interaction region between two solid bodies and elastic anisotropic properties of the top structure of a railway track, which differ in three main directions: along the rails, along the sleepers and vertically downwards. Based on the model of the wheel-rail contact the maximum stresses are determined which take place in the rail in the presence of wheel defects (e.g. flat spot, weld-on deposit, etc.). In this paper, the solution of the inverse problem is presented, i.e., investigation of the influence of the strength of a wheel impact upon rails on wheel defects as well as evaluation of the stresses emerging in rails.

articleTitle: Information and mathematical models for evaluation of the effectiveness and quality of the university
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Possible approaches to building the information and mathematical models to evaluate of the effectiveness and quality of the University are discussed in this paper. We characterize cycle of university management, determine the factors affecting the performance activity of universities, identify indicators of assessment of effectiveness and quality, formulate the problem of university management through the organization of control by this indicators. Proposes and explains the concept of integrated distributed information space and state the main problems that must be overcome in its implementation. Discusses the choice of the mathematical model of the organization of control of the effectiveness and quality of the University as a basis for making management decisions. Examines the complexity of the task of assessment of quality at the University, posit that the decision this problems by standard methods is very difficult. For the particular case of the solution of this task provides an example of using the randomized algorithm of stochastic optimization.

Author Keywords: evaluate of the effectiveness and quality of the University

articleTitle: Active infrared sensor for monitoring protected areas
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The analysis of typical ways to build tools of control of the security perimeter and intrusion into the protected area. The method of compensation of the effect of ambient light, the block diagram and measuring information processing algorithm of active infrared sensor of reflecting type, allowing to use it to register movement, is reviewed. The results of experimental studies of the device to control the intrusion into the protected area on the basis of active infrared sensor of reflecting type are considered.

articleTitle: Investigation of internet influence on users social needs
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In this paper we consider some results of a survey of today's Internet users of different ages and fields of activity, living in cities and settlements of different sizes, to identify their assessment of social needs' dynamic under Internet's influence. The effect of Internet on the feel of danger and risk, power and sense of domination over other people, belonging to a certain group, popularity and acknowledgment and education are considered. The results of the survey reveal the preservation of a variety of points of view with prevalence of significant change of social needs of the users caused by Internet influence.

articleTitle: Novel normalization technique for chaotic Pseudo-random number generators based on semi-implicit ODE solvers
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper considers the general structure of Pseudo-random binary sequence generator based on the numerical solution of chaotic differential equations. The proposed generator architecture divides the generation process in two stages: numerical simulation of the chaotic system and converting the resulting sequence to a binary form. The new method of calculation of normalization factor is applied to the conversion of state variables values to the binary sequence. Numerical solution of chaotic ODEs is implemented using semi-implicit symmetric composition D-method. Experimental study considers Thomas and Rössler attractors as test chaotic systems. Properties verification for the output sequences of generators is carried out using correlation analysis methods and NIST statistical test suite. It is shown that output sequences of investigated generators have statistical and correlation characteristics that are specific for the random sequences. The obtained results can be used in cryptography applications as well as in secure communication systems design.

articleTitle: Noise immunity enhancement by using a genetic-like coding algorithm for metric source without introduction of additional redundancy
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The problem of increasing noise immunity for sending messages usually solved by introducing the additional redundancy or by re-transmission of distorted fragment of the message. At the same time, the resulting delay is not always acceptable. An original concept for irredundant code efficiency rising is discussed. It is shown that some genetic-like algorithm applying to the class of permutative equivalent codes can suggest some code that will be too much stable in respect of disturbance appearance. Source space topology, concordant metrization procedure, miscellaneous error structure can be properly taking into account in technical feasibility of this algorithm. Examples of 2D Euclidean source spaces and their coding are presented. Reduction achieved for average displacement of decoding is at least 32% better than that for average values or at least five standard deviations.

articleTitle: Implementation and auditing of risk management for the oil and gas company
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article discusses aspects of the implementation and audit of the risk management system, implemented on the basis of modern standards for the enterprises of the oil and gas industry. Shows several practical examples of the implementation of the risk management process in the PDCA cycle proposed IMS model which contains all the basic entities to perform the audits (criteria, metrics, finding etc.), in relation to the enterprises of oil and gas industry.

articleTitle: Modern education: Challenges, status, prospects
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The relevance of the article is determined by a new socio-cultural situation, conditioned by the development of the information society. There are unknown cultural practices, intellectual and emotional needs, value orientations against the background of a significant decrease in the communicative and cognitive abilities of students, necessary for functioning not only in the educational environment of a higher educational institution, but also in professional activity. The purpose of the article is to investigate the question of quality of education as a key resource for the development of mankind and man, the conditions for reducing social risks and creating a strategy for managing success to ensure a decent quality of life.

Author Keywords: the quality of human potential and social risks

articleTitle: The algorithm of making environmental management decisions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of making environmental management decisions that take into account the interests of the enterprise in the form of profit and the interests of society and the state, by reducing damage to the environment. The authors pay attention to the process of making environmental management decisions. Proposed algorithm for making environmental management decisions is presented. The proposal for use ecological and economic evaluation of decisions considering the ecological component of the profits of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Functional modeling of business processes for development of control and monitoring systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper explores the features of functional modeling of the process of development of control and monitoring systems, using the example of the system of energy-saving control of technological objects.

articleTitle: Parametric identification of mechatronic system with induction and synchronous electric drive
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The greatest progress is observed in variable speed AC electric drives. The article presents principles and approaches to the synthesis of structures and parameters of corrective connections of AC electric drives with field regulated reluctance machine. It is shown that the quality of the control parameters depends on the conditions for setting the internal regulation loop of the electromagnetic torque. It is known that the parameters of electromechanical converters change in a wide range (2-3 times) and depend on the operating modes of the electric drive. The article draws attention to the algorithm of identifying the parameters of a high-speed loop of regulation electromagnetic torque using synchronous detection methods. This approach allows to define the parameters of the control object, compare the limit capabilities of different types of variable speed electric drives, estimate the range of changes in the parameters of the electrical machine, which is necessary for successful selection of the structure and parameters of the regulation structure. The research was supported by RSF.

articleTitle: Integration of quality assurance models for education on the basis of comparative analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper is devoted to quality assurance approaches in education and presents a comparative analysis of the Common Quality Assurance Framework (CQAF), the Standards and Guidelines for Quality Assurance in the European Higher Education Area (ESG), and the International Standards ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems - Requirements. The paper deals with the possibility to integrate them and discusses peculiarities of this integration.

articleTitle: Biological algorithms of control of a flying robot
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper considers a biologically inspired source-seeking algorithm in the system of three-dimensional spatial tracking based on biologically inspired behaviour-based approaches. Tracking system is a flying robot, for example, unmanned aerial vehicle or a multicopter. The flying robot searches hazardous pollutants in dangerous environments. The task of the flying robot is to find the source of invisible pollutions. Both the inertia of angle rotation and decision-making inertia have been added to the search algorithm. The inertia of decision-making of the flying robot operates like the cognitive inertia of natural organisms, which resists behaviour change and this resistance is defined by the coefficient of resistance to the changing control signal. In this work considers biologically-inspired behaviours of intellectual robots as a homeostatic system, in which typical modes of a robot behaviours, such as mutual search, neutrality, competition or pursuit are possible. The contribution of this paper is to propose discrete mathematical models of a robot's movements in the radiation field using evolution equations of biological systems and setting trends of step-by-step rotations in three-dimensional space. The aim of this work is to create a model of a changing control signal in searching movements of flying robots. We provide the simulation and experimental results using a proposed model, which shows the dependence of the flying robot tactics change on the coefficient of resistance to the changing control signal and shows the mutual search and neutrality modes for flying robots.

articleTitle: Process-service approach to e-learning design
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article touches upon issues concerning process-service approach to e-learning design and business processes management. The business process based on “black box” model has been considered utilizing methodology IDEF0 and quality tools. The process setting has been justified. Business process risks have been analysed and methods of their analysis have been described.

articleTitle: Institutional and organizational aspects of regional marine transport system strategic development
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents an approach for the building of institutional and organizational fundamentals of a regional marine transportation system strategic development by means of adaptation of a modern vision of the cluster functional purpose and formalization of a structural and logical model of the regional marine transport and logistics cluster model.

articleTitle: Brushstroke rendering algorithm for a painting robot
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A painting robot ARTCYBE is a machine developed to imitate an ability of a human painter to create realistic images with acrylic paints and a brush. In this paper a brushstroke rendering algorithm for this robot is presented. The algorithm converts a source bitmap image into a set of brushstrokes which we call a brushstroke map. The brushstroke map can be unambiguously transformed into a list of commands driving the painting robot. Simulated paintings obtained by proposed algorithm are represented. Advantages of the described algorithm in comparison to other known brushstroke rendering algorithms are discussed.

articleTitle: Improvement of the monitoring system of the technical condition of buildings
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the security systems at all stages of the construction of buildings and structures, the analysis at the sites during operation risk monitoring measures, taking into account possible emergencies.

articleTitle: Information and communication technologies in solving a free boundaries problems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The proposed paper is devoted to the information and communication technologies applied in the study of Stefan type free boundaries problems. Solutions to one-dimensional free boundary problem are obtained using MatLab matrix-oriented environment.

articleTitle: Study of spherically symmetric hypothermia and biological cryodestruction tissues using Matlab
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The one-dimensional problem with a free boundary that describes processes of cooling and freezing biological tissue using cryoprobes with applicator of spherical and hemispherical shapes is studied in this paper. A difference scheme is constructed. To solve the difference problem the algorithm is developed by a matrix-oriented environment (MatLab). The results in this paper are presented in graph form.

articleTitle: The cashless payment device for vending machines — Import substitution in the sphere of vending
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In this paper the notion of vending and the main tasks of a modern vending company are disclosed, one of the main goals of which is to provide as many payment methods as possible. Vending machines are most often located in large companies, large offices, institutions, and enterprises. The aim of the vending company is to increase the speed of customer service. This paper describes own development — a device for cashless payment. The device allows employee to pay for purchases using electronic passes. This solution allows vending companies not to worry about problems with cash (banknotes and coins), encashment and change, increasing the number of customers served per unit of time, what, in its turn, increases the income of the organization. And for the ultimate buyer, this method of payment saves time greatly.

articleTitle: Quality estimation of continuing professional education of technical specialists
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The state-of-the art education system should be in time for the knowledge-intensive technologies, that are developing with a high pace and be as mobile and effective as possible. The development of science-intensive technologies is developing with a tremendous pace, so the knowledge obtained in the university is quickly becoming obsolete, therefore the modernization of equipment should go in synchronism with the modernization of knowledge of technical specialists, as well as the knowledge of academic staff in this area. The role of continuous professional education, focused on priority areas of science and technology and interacting with production is becoming increasingly important in the context of the transition of the Russian economy to an innovative development model. The article presents an approach to the development of training programs, that basis on the components of the process according to the Deming cycle model, which is the main model of the quality management system. The analysis of the quality of the implementation of continuing professional education programs were done. According to the developed course feedback questionnaires, recommendations for improving the programs and the methods of quality estimation were described. This document will be of interest to everybody who are interested or are in charge of evaluating quality in higher education or in continuous professional education. The results of the article will make it possible to make an important contribution to international literature in the context of the globalization of higher education. Evaluation of the quality of continuing education and the process of its improvement is a timely and important task, both for universities and for enterprises.

articleTitle: Application of the hierarchy analysis method for the management of stomatological assistance quality
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The conceptual questions of the application of the method of analyzing hierarchies in the management of the quality of dental care are considered. General rules and an algorithm for conducting such an analysis are proposed with the aim of solving multicriterial choice problems in the field of improving the organization of the Russian dental service.

Author Keywords: the organization of a dental service

articleTitle: Modified real-time wavelet algorithm to increase the measurement accuracy of local signal parameters
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper considers modifications of a real-time discrete wavelet transform and problems related to local signal parameters measurement. Furthermore this work proposes a good alternative for a wavelet decomposition architecture which could help to increase restore accuracy of local signals. It is shown that developed cascade algorithm with synchronization has minimal computational costs and provides minimum error in local signal measurement process at the same time.

articleTitle: Modeling of crop productivity of agricultural crops with climate change at regional level and issues of disposal of pollutants with irrigated land
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The country's food security is a strategic task. Going climate change exacerbates this task. The paper suggests one of the possible approaches to solving the problem of forecasting the yield of the main agricultural crops. Numerical experiments were carried out for the conditions of the irrigation system located in the zone of insufficient moisture.

articleTitle: Marketing platform of organization of system-spatial complex «PSE» (Production — Science — Education)
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the essence of the marketing platform of organization and functioning of the system-spatial complex <;<;PSE>> (production - science - education). The authors shows the role of marketing architecture in the organization of marketing activities to promote technologies and innovative culture created by clusters of <;<;PSE>> complex. Marketing architecture is considered as the way of commensurate use of marketing potential, as well as the way of redistribution of marketing resources in the value creation chain designed by units of <;<;PSE>> complex.

articleTitle: Information-measurement and control system “smart house” as object of practice-oriented training of master's degree “instrumentation technology”
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The principles of the comprehensive practice-oriented training of bachelor's and master's degree “Instrumentation Technology” in the context of the information-measuring system “Smart house” are reviewed.

articleTitle: Cloud technology as innovative way in engineering and economic education
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In recent years the development of information and communication technologies, the formation of global computer networks has resulted in the creation of new innovative ways of growth, in particular, the implementation of cloud computing, which have been applied in all spheres of economy and business. The formation of innovative economy has led to the need for contemporary approaches in other areas. Last years, cloud technologies have been actively used in the field of engineering and economic education. The introduction and use of cloud services are analyzed. Forms of cloud computing's representation are considered. The estimation of financial indicators of the world cloud computing market is given. Particular attention is paid to the prospects of introducing cloud services in education. The financial assessment of the global cloud computing market in education is carried out. A study in the field of employing cloud services in higher education institutions was conducted. Tendencies of development and application of cloud technologies in engineering and economic education are revealed. The comparative analysis of the cloud systems of training existing for today offered by various producers is provided. The advantages of cloud computing are defined, and also the risks arising at introduction of cloud services are analysed.

articleTitle: Mobile authentication over hand-waving
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article contains information about the ability to authenticate a user on the movements of the smartphone in his hand during user interaction with the screen. Currently, user authentication based on their individual characteristics is very popular. The article considers one of the methods of authentication based on behavioral biometrics. Using the proposed model of the application The possibility of recognizing the user on the movement of the hand with the smartphone was evaluated. An application model for continuous user authentication is proposed, which uses hand-waving as an authentication tool.

articleTitle: Towards visual analytics tasks for the security information and event management
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Visual analytics is an actively developing multidisciplinary research area which can be successfully used in the field of information security management. The visual analytics techniques are used to monitor information security level of the information system and form situation awareness of the security officer. However, there are still some open issues in visual analytics tasks to be considered. This paper presents main challenges existing in this area and proposes possible solutions of these challenges.

articleTitle: Model estimates of the probability of risk events in the system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: There are introduced models of risk events assessment in the system in the article. Bank is represented as complex financial system. Special attention is paid to the models of credit risk assessment that can be used in any production system.

articleTitle: Enhancing the functionality of the procedures of encoding and decoding BCH codes
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The possibility of describing the encoding and decoding procedures Bose-Chaudhuri-Hocquenghem codes using the summation operations modulo 2 is researched. This allows you to simplify these procedures and improve efficiency by correcting the error of the triplicate. There identified coding equations and triangular match tables: the syndrome - the distortion of the position.

articleTitle: Provision of quality of technological process of manufacturing machine-building manufacturing products
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: On the example of operations for manufacturing the “Axis” detail, the effectiveness of statistical control of the technological production process for the “Nalchik plant of highvoltage equipment” is demonstrated. Specific recommendations on the effective quality assurance of parts are given.

articleTitle: The information security risk management
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The main formal tasks of the information security risk management process using functional and contextual models reflecting the basic concepts and basic functions of information security risk management systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of the transport system development & prospects of transport construction in Russia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The basic stages of transport system of the country and transport services development. Necessity of amplification (strengthening) of coordination and development of researches is shown in the field of transport construction with maintenance of his(its) normative equipment with duly entering into norms and rules of building manufacture of achievements of adjacent fields of knowledge and the approved experience of the completed building objects.

articleTitle: Development of the principles of the quality management system which based on the economic theory of value
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper presents theory of a value, allowing to study in detail the interests concerning the quality improvement of both consumers and other stakeholders development of principles of quality management.

articleTitle: Systematic approach and advanced marketing in public-private partnerships
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article explains the relationship and interdependence of advanced marketing and a systematic approach in the development of public-private partnerships. Approaches to the formulation and solution of problems based on public-private partnerships. The main directions of improvement and the basic characteristics of public-private partnerships from the standpoint of advanced marketing. The necessity of a systematic approach to increase the socio-ecological-economic efficiency as the most important outcome in the management of the development of public-private partnerships.

articleTitle: Problems of quality management of the subgrade construction of high-speed railways
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with basics of subgrade design of high-speed railways. Requirements to quality management at different stages: engineering survey, designing, construction.

articleTitle: Synergetic of information and communication technologies and quality tools in the tasks of engineering management
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper touches upon the fundamental questions of organisation and production resource management, conditions of their sustainable development that enable the young professionals to gain new additional competences within the educational training programs of an engineer-manager. The similarity of the tasks, solutions and synergy of the educational process are declared in the system of basic priorities of Total Quality Management (TQM), modern information and communication technologies and digital economy in general.

articleTitle: Overview of the global e-learning systems market
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Lately the development of information and communication technologies has led to the creation of a new type of economy, called information economy, based on the introduction of the latest advances in computer technology. The innovative economy expansion requires new advanced approaches in all areas of development, including engineering and economic education. In the last few years, the evolution of computer networks and the Internet has reformatted educational processes, moving from traditional forms of education to distance ones through electronic learning systems. The article deals with the concept of electronic distance education. The analysis of the existing systems of electronic learning on the main characteristics, including support for application languages, database management systems, and the availability of examination systems is carried out. New forms of distance education, in the form of massive open online courses (MOOC), which have spread over the past few years, are considered. The research of the platforms supporting MOOC courses is conducted. The assessment of prospects for the e-learning development, based on the analysis of financial parameters, the number of online course participants, distribution capabilities.

articleTitle: A solution to a problem of simulating solar microwave radiation to restore human homeostasis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the original hypothesis of identification of unknown parameters of low-frequency fluctuations of the cosmic microwave background. Its essence consists in the fact that in the process of evolution of organisms under the influence of microwave radiation of the sun characteristics of its low-frequency fluctuations are reflected in the basic properties of the neural mechanism of regulation of the body and the person, in particular. Brief description of the hardware implementation of the simulation tool microwave radiation of the Sun. Microbiological studies using specified device showed high its efficiency in the reduction of resistant properties of the most common opportunistic pathogens and improve the rheological properties of blood. Many of the general laws of life studied microorganisms with other cellular structures of the human body give reason to make positive view on the use of simulated microwave radiation of the sun in the prevention and treatment of a wide range of infectious and noninfectious diseases, including oncology.

articleTitle: Formalization of stochastic restrictions in risk assessment models of investment projects
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Generally, investment decision is an evaluation of the proposed alternatives for the investor using a set of indicators. Evident, that to the start of the investment, the project should be finished and valid, however, search of investment resources and other difficulties can delay significantly start of the investment stage, which would increase risks. Therefore, it is important in addition to evaluating the traditional financial indicators of the project to identify and assess substantial risk of delayed investment project implementation, which is due to the variability of investment climate. The proposed method allows solving the task of investment projects selection under uncertainty and market competition and provides investors with information in probability sense about preferable projects because of the possibility of their timely implementation.

articleTitle: Digital economy in management and evaluation of transport and logistics projects and life cycle processes
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A potential formalization of factor management and assessment algorithm, automated modeling system architecture and performance evaluation of major infrastructural transport and logistics projects and processes is suggested, based on numerical and analytical methods of digital economy, qualitative (verbal) and quantitative assessment indicators and criteria, economic logistics model and efficient computational procedures.

articleTitle: Mathematical models of traffic flow of diffusion type at stochastic conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Mathematical models of the transport flow based on the equation of continuity of the transport stream are analyzed. A method for approximating the observational data on the relationship between the flow density and the velocity of motion based on the modification of the method of least squares is developed. A mathematical model of a diffusion-type traffic flow in stochastic conditions is proposed.

articleTitle: Service management e-learning model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The object of research is the electronic educational environment of the university. The purpose of this paper is to present electronic-educational environment of the university in the form of services. The term service is embedded notion of service to the business or service that measured by business indicators. Result of the work a reasoned catalog of services electronically University educational environment that can be used as a guide for the project of such environment in different educational institutions.

articleTitle: Implementation of the risk management principles in the model of business processes of machine-building enterprise
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The use of the risk management principles to reduce the number of dangerous factors arising in the course of principal activity is shown in the example of machine-building enterprise. The risks for several processes are identified and a risk map is built. To form a risk management system the standard image of business processes was transformed by adding the necessary element - the subject of management.

articleTitle: A statistical approach to the assessment of security threats information system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers issues of assessment of security threats to information systems. The analysis of existing approaches to the problem and requirements of the national standards. Noted the disadvantage of the classical approach to the assessment of possible threats. Proposed an alternative approach based on the use of statistics of incidents, in particular, proposed the creation of a single database of incidents.

articleTitle: TechnoMOOC development of the basis of remote lab access
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The debate on replacement of traditional learning by massive open online courses is an ongoing one since the launch and success of million-user platforms like Coursera or Udacity, followed by online courses offered now by the majority of universities. Still, significant share of online courses are IT-, data science, business, theory and humanities oriented, as in these cases the students do not require equipment or other resources that need to be accessed only onsite; on the other hand, the need for onsite access and actual equipment operation prevents exponential growth of technology-related MOOCs (technoMOOCs), despite the huge demand in the field. The paper examines demand for remote control and online learning, identifying the trends in remote labs and relevant technoMOOC development from supplier side — in a form of preferable technology and target audience.

articleTitle: Crimean region resort and spa sphere sustainable development modeling
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Nowadays mathematical tools elaboration for regional resort and spa social and economic system development is up-to-date. Economic units which serve tourist needs are complex objects for modeling, they are involved to regional multiple specific interrelated tourism sphere industrial processes and coherent with ecology and society. In the article it was suggested Crimea region tourism sustainable development modeling with peculiar factors and indicators applying based on models of R. Casagrandi and S. Rinaldi [1], M. Begeulova [2], A. Kazak [3], Ye. Lukyanova [4], D. Khazova [5].

articleTitle: Program module for calculating the optimal interval of preventive substitutions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Railway transport is one of the main transport modes of the Russian Federation, which is strategically important for the country. Artificial constructions on the railways are complex and responsible elements of the track economy. The probability of their failure-free operation must be high enough. For the adoption of optimal solutions for managing the technical state of man-made structures, it is necessary to use probabilistic operating models, build algorithms for calculating reliability and development indices using these algorithms of the software package, which makes it possible to automate the process of controlling the operation of artificial constructions on railways.

articleTitle: Geotechnical structures foundation stabilization technological processes control
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The reasonability of technological control for geotechnical structures foundation strength targeted development during the construction is shown. The procedure of the weak soils stabilization and the real time monitoring technological processes management is proposed using the example of Northern Latitudinal Path.

articleTitle: Special aspects of applying the term “non-contact method of measurement” in monitoring of passive quantities
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article attempts to form an adequate understanding of the term “non-contact method of measurement”, the definition of which is absent in actual documents on standardization. The contrast in the use of the term for active and passive quantities is demonstrated. The details of applying the term in the presence and absence of sampling, and during non-destructive testing are considered. The difference of terms “non-contact method of measurement” and “non-invasive method of measurement” is shown. Specifications of the concepts “contact”, “element of measuring instrument” and “measurement object” in respect to the conduct of non-contact measurement are presented.

articleTitle: Authentication method for the keyboard usage based on fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The aim of this work is to develop an authentication method using keyboard typing based on fuzzy logic. The paper considers a function that takes into account the minimum and maximum limits of biometric characteristics and the dependence of the stability of keyboard typing on its stability. As a result, a deviation factor is introduced to determine how much the biometric characteristic of the user after normalization will vary from the average value, which in its turn allows to determine the percentage of authenticity of the computer information system user. As a result, the probability of occurrence of errors of the first and second kind is reduced in comparison with the existing methods of authentication.

articleTitle: Lean manufacturing in Russia: Myth or reality?
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Lean Manufacturing is a concept of organization managing intended for minimization of various costs and maximum consumer orientation. This system consists of a variety of tools such as Just-In-Time system, Kanban system or 5S system; their sharing allows of realization the philosophy of Lean Manufacturing. Russian companies face a number of challenges when implementing this concept - incorrect interpretation of approaches of Lean Manufacturing, internal barriers represented by the peculiarity of managing approaches in domestic leadership, and the lack of support by the government. It is necessary to identify the problems of system implementation in time and focus on solving all sorts of problems standing in the way of successful operation of Lean Manufacturing in the organization. It will result in strengthening the enterprise's competitiveness on the world stage.

articleTitle: Intelligent software for the quality management of the technical solutions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The present paper outlines the results of developments in the field of the computer supported invention. Most attention is paid to the problem of computer aided designing in the initial stages, where synthesis and analysis of new technical systems is carried out. Construction of new technical systems is based on using of data- and knowledge bases containing descriptions of the technical solutions and heuristic procedures for their handling. The synthesis of functional principles for technically new systems is carried out with use of experts knowledge. The considered approach has been applied for synthesis of new technical systems with different functional purposes and has shown high efficiency in computer-aided construction.

Author Keywords: analysis and synthesis of the technical solutions

articleTitle: Thermal control of potatoes quality
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Increasing availability of thermal imaging technology made it possible to carry out thermal quality control of vegetables and fruits in the process of sorting them. For the effective management of thermal control, it is necessary to ensure its optimal regimes, which are largely determined by the power and time of the thermal impact. In order to choose these parameters it is necessary to know the thermophysical properties of the plant tissues of the control objects. In the article the scheme of the automated system of thermal control of potato quality is shown. The solution of the problem of increasing its efficiency by selecting rational parameters of the thermal effect on the object of control is shown. In order to solve the problem, the method of modeling temperature fields in the potato tuber was used, as well as the method and apparatus were developed by us for a non-contact measurement of the thermophysical properties of vegetable tissues of fruits and vegetables.

articleTitle: Research of ways of preserving the quality of grinded food products in the process of grinding
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the article the analysis of structures of cruciform blades grinders food for energy efficiency. The proposed design of the knife, providing reduction of energy consumption in the process of operation.

Author Keywords: the wedge angle of the wedge
the blade of the knife grinding

articleTitle: Improvement of innovative-investment potential of the problematic regions economy on the basis of activation of institutes of development in process of improvement of the mechanism of state-private partnership
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The peculiarities of formation of innovative-investment strategy in the economy of the troubled region were investigated. The main ways of GDP growth were defined. The role of development institutions as an important instrument for the implementation of innovative investment strategies in the region's economy was shown. We concluded that Federal development institutions as a tool for the development and implementation of innovative investment strategies in the region's economy require a clear functional attachment and orientation for the decision of problems socially-economic development of specific types of regions.

articleTitle: The method of selection of innovative solutions based on an assessment of the efficiency reserves
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Correct and efficient selection of innovative solutions is the most important part of the whole process of implementation of innovations in small businesses. In this regard, the study of the mechanism for the selection of innovative solutions based on an assessment of efficiency reserves is a vital task. In this article, using analytical methods, systematic approach, logical methods of research are analyzed and discussed various aspects of the selection process for innovative solutions. It is concluded that for the characterization of the influence of selected factors on the decision and identify efficiency reserves should use a point-factor method with the use of weight coefficients of importance.

articleTitle: Kabardian and Karachay-Balkar aristocrats' children in the Dmitryevskiy semisquadron of military cantonists in the 1830s
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article analyzes the reasons for the referral of children of Kabardian and Karachay-Balkar aristocrats to the Dmitryevskiy semisquadron of comissioned cantonists.

articleTitle: Problems of planning and quality management in the design and construction of the Moscow-Kazan-Ekaterinburg High-Speed Railway
