publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the issues related to the development of the regulatory framework (building codes) for the design and construction of the high-speed railway line Moscow-Kazan-Ekaterinburg as a basis for monitoring and managing the quality of design and construction.

Author Keywords: deformation of the roadbed and its base

articleTitle: The functioning of small innovative enterprises created in partnership with state universities and natural persons
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article discusses methods of regulating the functioning of small innovative enterprises and primarily by the state. The article also presents measures of the state support of small business innovation. Are also proposals to improve the efficiency of the system and mechanisms of state support innovative small businesses.

articleTitle: Machinery manufacturing and construction organisations processes and safety efficiency evaluation based on lean manufacturing approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Every company (including machinery manufacturing and construction companies) leads to increase its activities' profitability and to improve quality performance indicators, such as processes operating and safety culture, safety level, human resources satisfaction level, and goodwill. Lean manufacturing and lean construction (derivative of lean manufacturing) enable to reach these goals. The article reviews methods of company efficiency increasing potential evaluation and aims to help in choosing the most important improvements fields. Upon the review results the article authors propose the efficiency improvement potential evaluation model for machinery manufacturing and construction companies based on lean manufacturing.

articleTitle: Education quality criteria within the competence model of the graduate
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Discusses the concept of quality of education, highlights the criteria and indicators of assessing its quality in the framework of theoretical and methodological research. Highlights the main requirements to level of preparation of graduates.

articleTitle: Development of the search robot for information security in web content
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of the method of self-learning of an artificial intelligence, based on the use of software tools for collecting information from various Internet resources. There is developed a web crawler that analyzes Internet resources for the presence of false articles by data mining methods based on an artificial intelligence and by self-learning through the mechanism of neural networks.

articleTitle: Adaptive noise reduction phonocardiograms based on wavelet transformation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The problem of adaptive reduction of noise of phonocardiograms (PCG) The problem of adaptive reduction of noise of phonocardiograms (PCG) based on wavelet transformation is considered in the article. Adaptive noise reduction is realized on the basis of the wavelet decomposition of the PCG using the Daubechies 4 wavelet function. The Daubechy 4 wavelet function is identical to the PCG patterns and well approximates the nonlinear local regions of the PCG. The proposed approach allows us to treat the PCG from physiological noise by high adaptively. The concept of decomposition is presented in the form of a set of filters that allow in automatic mode to remove noise by thinning twice at each stage of decomposition. On the basis of the obtained modeling results, the patterns of PCG, namely, mitral, pulmonary components of the PCG were identified.

articleTitle: Informatization of education in the context of post-industrialization: The difficulties
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A new turn in information revolution contributed to the formation of a new universal identity of the uniform postindustrial society. We refer to this phenomenon as the concept of a “New axial period”. The system of education, like all cultural institutions, turned out to be not ready for such a breakthrough in creating a new reality that entails certain problems. Among the problems are: pedagogical conservatism, technical underdevelopment of universities, information and technological imbalance in regions, a technocentric-anthropocentric methodological divide, poor moderate ability and the Internet traffic monitoring. If the educational institutions just follow the rapidly developing technologies, they will inevitably lag behind and the acquired knowledge will not bring them into line with the new realities. We suggest that educational institutions cooperate more closely with the software and hardware developers. Note that all the problems in education in the field of information technologies are not only and not so far the result of local failures and shortcomings. The education problems are quite regular; therefore, today there is the need for a qualitative new approach to the learning processes.

articleTitle: Methods and tools for education and research in the information society
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Simulation represents the major research method in all knowledge domains and a scientifically valid method of estimating the characteristics of complex systems used for decision making in different areas of engineering. The existing and projected systems can be explored effectively using mathematical models (analytical and simulation) implemented on high-performance computers, which act in this case as a tool of an experimenter with a model. The article addresses the problems of simulation as a method of research, the use of simulation in the study and design of complex systems, the future evolution of methods and tools for systems simulation, and construction of an education system model for the information society.

articleTitle: Identification of mechanical systems in the frequency area
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Mathematical models of a mechanical system in the time and frequency areas, which are realized by various software complexes, are considered. The results of identification of the experimental amplitude-frequency characteristic using the software complex IMS-I are presented. It is established that the design analysis method, in which one natural frequency (one mode) is considered does not provide the dynamic quality of the mechanical system, it is necessary to change the parameters for all available natural frequencies for analysis.

publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)

It is argued that the ideas and principles of this approach only partially meet the needs of training an engineer in the conditions of the modern development of science, technique, technology, production and it manifests itself in a whole series of contradictions arising when projecting a competent approach to engineering education, its logic and specifics.

publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)

The main features of the use of logical and structural analysis aimed at implementing the most important aspects of enterprise competitiveness management are considered.

articleTitle: Upgraded rotary cross-shaped food shredder knife
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article analyzes the process of grinding food products. The principle of operation of the plate knife of a food shredder is considered. The design of the knife is proposed, which ensures a reduction in power consumption during operation.

Author Keywords: the wedge angle of the wedge
the blade of the knife grinding

articleTitle: Management solutions in quality management and “black swans”
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The adoption of managerial decisions in quality management is characterized by the need to take into account both the presence of uncertainty and its impact on customer requirements, and the quality assessment as the degree to which the predicted result of innovation meets the expected requirements of consumers. It is proposed to use decision-making methods that do not take into account estimates of the probability of occurrence of random events as difficult to forecast. The advisability of using the concept of “black swans” in the formation of a multitude of considered random events is discussed.

articleTitle: A mechatronic system optimal control of the pipes cold rolling mill
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the search for optimal motion path of the positional electric drive under conditions of an indefinite (statistical) characteristics of the load. It is shown that the triangle is the optimum shape of the speed curve, and the ratio of its sides depends on the type of the load diagram, in particular on the influence of the main drive of the pilgering mill, and is independent on elasticity in systems. This thesis is proved analytically and confirms the results obtained by the mathematical model that considers the influence of the main drive of the drive feed systems. By statistical analysis of the oscillograms obtained on the real object allowed us to give recommendations for the optimal control of the electric drive of the cold pilgering mill 450. It is proved that the load point is related to the moment of pipe feeding, which occurs in the interval (0.6 ... 0.75) t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub>. The recommended ratio of the start time and the decelerating time is 2:1. Due to the optimal motion path, it is shown that the equivalent resistance moment is 25% lower, and this has allowed increasing productivity of the mill. articleTitle: Investigation of the Internet-community readiness for innovative activity
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article considers the results of a survey of the Internet space in order to identify interest and ideas about innovative activities and readiness for it. Understanding of the essence of innovation activity by respondents, its effectiveness, participation in innovation competitions, awareness of leading innovative programs, participation in the registration of intellectual property and other aspects are considered in the article. The results of the survey reveal the preservation of diversity of points of view with the prevalence of a significant change in interest and innovation activity.

articleTitle: Technology and practice of ICT disciplines maintenance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The universal diagram of creation of the virtual practical works for a row of disciplines of ICT is offered. Use the VirtualBox virtualization system for different variants of the practical works organization is considered. The diagram of the organization of a workshop on installation of the selected UNIXserver is provided. The conclusion about need of a combination of operation for a display class to independent operation on a uniform technological basis is drawn.

articleTitle: Creating automation tools with BIM-programs for designing elements of metal bridges
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers an example of extending the BIM-program when designing elements of the metal bridge. The algorithm for placing the bolts in the nodes of the main through trusses of the metal bridge is provided. Examples of dialog boxes created with the help of the Tekla Open API which illustrate the implementation of the proposed algorithm are provided.

articleTitle: Computer modelling of statically working plain plate systems using smart spreadsheets
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Nowadays and with the intensive development of computer technology, a widespread number of numerical approaches for solving structural mechanics problems came up on light. The most popular and versatile among these approaches is that on of finite elements (FEA or FEM).

publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Use of the well-developed existing railway network of the European territory of Russia to create a viable transport link between Europe and Asia in order to increase the competitiveness of the Euro-Asian Railway Transport Corridors (EARTC).

Author Keywords: methodology for forecasting the development of EARML

articleTitle: Providing a synergetic effect in the quality improvement of the railway automatics system, MPC Ebilock 950, maintenance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article raises the issues of improving the quality of servicing microprocessor systems of railway automatics and telemechanics. The analysis of algorithms and schemes of interaction between the operational state of the STC divisions and the MPC Ebilock 950 service centers showed the existence of some shortcomings that hamper improving the quality of servicing microprocessor devices. The alternative scheme of interaction between the maintenance service participants is proposed. It bases on the information exchange through the application created by the authors. The application allows controlling the quality and terms of the performance of service works in order to accumulate information on methods for eliminating complex failures and to automate the process of processing requests by the service centers.

articleTitle: Safety evaluation of application of waste silicon metal production
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The security issue of using waste for the production of metallic silicon - silicon dust, ultra-fine material obtained in the process of gas purification furnaces, is interdisciplinary problem, because the resulting modifier is used in many industries. The use of silica dust also has broad opportunities to improve the strength properties of construction materials, in this regard, one of the most important issues is the safety of people who produce and use this material as a modifier, and a comprehensive analysis of the impact on human health of silica dust will unambiguously answer the question of the appropriateness of its use.

Author Keywords: waste from production of silicon metal

articleTitle: New forms of young students' socialization in the Internet space
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Involvement of youth students into virtual space often leads to replacement of traditional forms of socialization. Young people are increasingly seeking to communicate, play and learn in the Internet space. As a result, new forms of socialization arise, the personality of a new type is being formed. Article represents new classification of the Internet socialization forms of youth.

Author Keywords: new forms of socialization of youth

articleTitle: Approach to development of assignments with graphical solutions for MOOC course
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Assessment tools in MOOCs vary from simple tests to customizable scripts with adaptive feedback, but commonly they check student's submission for correct answer. In real life we often meet cases where many correct answers are possible and the best solution requires good feeling of the context of implementation. This paper describes an approach experimentally implemented for online course of video technologies where engineering tasks are often based on real-life experience, not just specifications and rules. To transfer this experience a multi-layer model of assessment was proposed and partly implemented in experimental tasks. This example shows how assessment tool turns out a training platform where technically correct solution is just a start of work and variable feedback leads students to understanding of engineering approach, given by the author of the tasks.

articleTitle: Import Substitution in Medicine. The Set of Marketing Researches for Domestic Device “PARDUS-R”
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article deals with the problem of import ubstitution in Russia in the field of medical equipment. The lading task of import substitution in medicine is the creation of domestic competitive products. Based on the conducted marketing research practical recommendations on increasing the demand and increasing the competitiveness on the product “Pardus - R” are set out.

articleTitle: The human body as the element of the computer network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper considers WBAN and intersegment WBAN communication approaches. At present, WBAN is rapidly developing. So, it's necessary to study not only WBAN standards and technologies, but also WBAN to WBAN interaction, especially using IBC. In this work the IEEE 802.15.6 standard is considered, BodyCom technology has been studied. Practical tasks that can be solved by IBC WBAN intersegment communication are described. We offer a new approach to intersegment communication in IBC WBAN, where different WBAN are represented as segments of a single network. The behavior of the approach at different OSI model layers is considered. Research can be useful in applications such as medicine, sports, education, entertainment and Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Analysis of the electromagnetic field of the source of contact interference in a vehicle
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The author reviews the structure of a mobile radio facility system, presents an analysis of electromagnetic fields of the transmitter and of the contact disturbance source in vehicles, and provides a ratio for calculating the signal in the receiver antenna.

articleTitle: Analysis of key terms of knowledge domains to support research
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The development and enhancement of the effectiveness of scientific research in the learning process requires the use of new tools for working with knowledge using the methods of knowledge engineering: methods of Data Mining, Text Mining, semantic information processing technologies. The use of sets of video materials on a large scale for automatic annotation is a new task and requires the development of methods for its solution. To review the literature on such methods, algorithms for obtaining and analyzing key terms are developed, and a special feature is the consideration of the dynamics of trends in knowledge domains.

articleTitle: Problems of corporate management systems integration
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents an overview of major problems of integrated management systems implementation, provides a discussion on various integration problems of target management systems, both in terms of integration among systems, as well as in terms of integration into overall organizational structure of the company. Problems recognition process provides means for proper practical ways to resolve them and initiates the process of corporate transformation, which will ensure the execution of the best corporate strategies and adoption of successful long term corporate plans.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of internal audit of processes in the organization
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article compares two approaches to the organization of internal audit - audit of units and audit of processes.

articleTitle: Creating competence centres to support the development of the saint petersburg clean technologies cluster for urban environment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the framework of the federal and regional socioeconomic development strategies, as well as the interstate regional initiatives, a pilot project for creating an ecological and safe environment for living is implemented in Saint-Petersburg; the project embraces the introduction of energy saving and energy efficient technologies in all economic sectors. In the light of the foregoing, in 2014, an international consortium named Saint-Petersburg Cleantech Cluster for urban environment was launched. The cluster takes part in international and thematic projects aimed at the development and adoption of innovative technologies. In order to implement the federal programs related to fast adoption of energy saving and energy efficient technologies in industry, it is essential to train managers and entrepreneurs to engage them in clean technologies. This article sums up the potential role of the university community as a competence centre, a platform for cultivating a new attitude of economical energy and ecology management, of scientific and entrepreneurial research, and of competitive student initiative. The article analyses the influence of the federal and regional thematic competitions on the way the participating students view the topical issue of clean technologies implementation and on the participants' engagement in the development and creation of respective competences. The general conclusion is that universities can serve as competence centres within which the student communities will help promoting the clean technologies culture. The main result of the research is the proposed form of cooperation of the university and the cluster with the aim of encouraging the “clean” technologies culture. Research methods: the author of the article cites the expert opinions of the clean technologies clusters residents, of clusters theoreticians, energy saving and energy efficiency management experts, and university community members. The data base was composed of the open access data of the clusters and consortia, of universities, competitions and government agencies. Besides, the article proposes a research into the students' opinions based on the “real situation focus group” method.

articleTitle: Modeling of mass transfer in extraction of vegetable raw materials
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper considers a mass transfer model for extraction in a solid-liquid system, which is a boundary-value problem for a two-dimensional equation of elliptic-hyperboloparabolic type.

articleTitle: The operational reliability of a railway track in geo-extreme conditions of the Yamal Peninsula
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents a typical construction of the roadway of the railway line on the Yamal Peninsula. Also presents are the provisions of an integrated method, taking into consideration geo-extreme conditions of the Russian Arctic Zone, containing the solutions aimed at operational reliability improvement of the railway line.

articleTitle: On innovation activities of industrial companies of the north and the arctic under the conditions of resource restrictions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The work is devoted to solving the urgent problem of developing scientific grounds of modernization and innovation industrial development of the North and the Arctic of the Russian Federation under the conditions of resource restrictions, first of all investment and financial ones. The goal of the research is to elaborate theoretical and methodological grounds for potentialities of modernization and innovation activities of industrial enterprises. The work uses various research methodologies. Solvency of thirty-eight companies of the North and the Arctic for 2013-2015 is studied by the following main indicators: current solvency coefficient, current liquidity coefficient, coefficient of provision with circulating own assets, and coefficient of autonomy.

articleTitle: Quality management of software development processes using the qualimetric approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the consideration of qualimetric management methods applied to the process of developing software systems. The main approaches to the construction of qualimetric models allowing evaluating the effectiveness of the implementation of the development processes are considered: an approach based on constructing a structured function of the quality of the system, as well as an approach based on the applying of a complex indicator of the quality of the system.

articleTitle: The exodus of the circassians from the caucasus: About unknown manuscripts of Sh. Kuba plays
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of artistic solution of the “makhadzhirstvo” subject in the literature of the Circassian émigré community. In addition to the analysis of the dramatic conflict and its embodiment in this work, we also consider the language and specific speech of the characters; we also reveal features of artistic realization of historical events and destinies, etc. It should be noted, that in the considered work Kuba Shaban used the texts of lamentation songs of his own composition, as a peculiar background of the considered tragic pages of Circassians history, where he uses pleonasms as a stylistic means of the image. The work is investigated with the account of the spirit of the time of its creation.

articleTitle: Quality assessment of public-private partnership in the near-earth space surveillance programs in Russia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents a study of the mechanism of public-private partnership in the Russian Federation. It is shown that the use of such a mechanism in the study of near-Earth space is an urgent task for the Russian Federation and than such mechanism should be adopted in the near future. It is noted that public-private partnership will attract significant public scientific and economic resources in addition to state resources. It is shown that public-private partnership in the near-Earth space surveillance programs is at the initial stage in Russia. However, there are serious prerequisites for its successful development.

articleTitle: The anodic mechanical machining application for thread cutting of small diameters
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers the some features of the screw-threading process in the holes of tiny and the ultra-small diameter (d <;1.4 mm). The influence of diameter size on the regularities of machining and chip formation determines the reasons for the low reliability of machining and the ways to increase it.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of the existing payment systems on urban passenger transport
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the research results of the existing payment systems on urban passenger transport. The methodology for conducting a comparative analysis of travel payment systems has been proposed by authors. The criteria for their comparative evaluation has been formulated, the weight of each criterion has been determined for both groups of users. The rating of the payment systems has been determined. The advantages and disadvantages of studied fare collection systems have been determined based on the ratio of the experts total score for each system to the possible maximum score taking into account the significance of each criterion.

articleTitle: Application of the AHP/ANP to invention problems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper describes a number of computer-supported methods for invention problem solving by using the AHP/ANP. These methods are intended for creating of new mechanisms and may be useful for support of the following problems: strategic forecasting the evolution of mechanical devices having a certain functional assignment; a choice of rational analogues and prototypes from inventions databases; the synthesis and quality assessment of new conceptual solutions of mechanisms; the evaluation of novelty by examining the inventions. Application of AHP/ANP enables one to promote solving the foregoing problems through a systemic approach involving the use of multiple criteria for decision-making.

articleTitle: Analytical description of the deformation diagrams of concrete and pre-stressed high-strength reinforcement steel
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article offers an analytical description of the diagrams of deformation of concrete and pre-prestressed high-strength reinforcing steel used to develop methods of calculating reinforced-concrete elements with a combined prestress.

articleTitle: A power supply scheme and motor winding optimization of mechatronic modules
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper presents a model of a complex electromechanical system based on a new type of electromechanical converter - a field regulated reluctance machine (FRRM). The problem of optimal regulation of a multiphase electromechanical converter is formulated according to the criterion of minimum costs for the installed power of an electric drive and a semiconductor converter. The second task of optimizing the circuit of the power circuits of a semiconductor converter and an electric machine is formulated using the criterion of minimum electric losses. The results of optimization in the function of the nominal electromagnetic torque of the electric drive and the number of phases of the power semiconductor converter are presented. The research was supported by RSF.

Author Keywords: electric drive with field regulated reluctance machine

articleTitle: Development of the neural network method for analyzing the literary text from the point of view of genre identification
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article studies the issue of identification of literary texts with artificial neural networks. We showed that artificial neural networks for solving the problem of classifying literary texts makes it possible to obtain a true result for determining the category of a text with a probability of 95%. However, determining the genre of a literary text is more difficult and in the worst case it is possible only with a probability of 75%.

articleTitle: The quality characteristics comparison of coordinates and time estimations using the PPP online services
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: We considered the range of PPP online services that solve the problem of high-precision coordinates and receiver time scale shift determination for the RINEX daily records. The comparative estimation of exact indicators of position determination for different geoids is given. The results contains the recommendations for use the online PPP services to solve the problem of time scales comparison.

articleTitle: Adaptive noise cancellation in ECG signal
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Control over the state of the cardiovascular system is found in cardiac monitoring devices, namely in electrocardiography. When registering electrocardiograms with the help of electrodes located on the patients torso, the impact of electrical and physiological disturbances is unavoidable. In this article presents a new approach of adaptive processing of ECG signals, to eliminate electrical and physiological disturbances. Synthesis of adaptive sequential filters is performed at the request of the American Heart Association. The proposed approach is based on adaptive sequential filtering of ECG signals in the time domain. With this filtration, the accuracy characteristics of the measured electrocardiographic information are increased and the noise robust identification of local sections ECG signal is obtained.

articleTitle: A mechatronic system control design with field regulated reluctance machine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Mechatronic modules with field regulated reluctance machine have improved mass-size parameters and can be used to drive the actuator valve of metallurgical production. The article shows the stages of synthesis of a mechatronic module elements': the selection of the parameters of the electric drive's power elements (the main dimensions of electromechanical converter), the control system (speed control loop). It shows an application area of the considered mechatronic modules for metallurgical production and traction mechanisms. Attention is paid to the specific characteristics of the electric drive.

Author Keywords: electric drive with field regulated reluctance machine

articleTitle: Model for assessing transport security in the region (based on the example of the Sverdlovsk region)
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Studies in the field of transport security are aimed more at finding new technical and technological solutions directly related to transport and the development of transport infrastructure. The authors of the work decided to look at the process of ensuring transport safety on a different plane-creating a model for assessing the processes presented at the territorial level. The assessment provides an opportunity to understand the key negative points and points of growth in ensuring a high level of transport security, both economically and socially. The authors formulate a model for assessing the transport security of the region, based on reference components such as the security and development of the automotive infrastructure that serves road transport, the most discussed and ineffective object in the matter of ensuring security in the Sverdlovsk region (Russia).

articleTitle: The method of planning of rational organization of the process of design and technological preparation for manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The problem of rational organization of the process of design and technological preparation for manufacturing with application of semantic Petri-Markov nets is considered. The method of parallelization of the stages of the works within design and technological preparation for manufacturing based on their semantic relations.

articleTitle: The influence of a difference of steps on load distribution between the turns of the threaded connection
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Using the equations of compatibility of deformation and equilibrium between the turns of the threaded connection solved the problem of load distribution in the turns of the thread. Based on the selection of the turns of the screw and nut with different pitches of effective design-technological method enabling to align the load distribution between turns and thereby increase the durability of threaded connections.

articleTitle: Development of a channel for recording phonocardiograms in electronic stethoscopes
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of developing a channel for recording phonocardiograms in electronic stethoscopes. The development of a channel for recording phonocardiograms for the further development of electronic stethoscopes is an actual task in the field of biomedical engineering for today. When registering phonocardiograms with an acoustic microphone (sensor) located on the patient's torso, the impact of environmental noise is unavoidable. To eliminate this interference, it is proposed to use a sequential filtering of interference, based on the model of an additive mixture of phonocardiograms and interference. Sequential filtering is implemented on the basis of active band pass filters for later increasing the accuracy and identification of phonocardiogram patterns. Unlike common band pass filters, this sequential filtering algorithm allows you to strengthen low-frequency sound waves of the heart and improve the accuracy of identifying the components of phonocardiograms. In order to demonstrate the work of the proposed approach, the article proposes the results of modeling in the environment of Proteus. The results of the study show the limitations of all methods of processing phonocardiograms used in electronic stethoscopes.

articleTitle: High involvement innovation: Analysing employee involvement and HR performance in the construction industry
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the context of competitive economy innovation is a key strategic imperative for any organization. Successful technological, marketing, and organizational innovations result in a sustainable competitive advantage and lead to better financial results. As it stands, the organizational innovation is considered to be a vehicle for technological and market development. It is, in turns, driven by the involvement of employees, which therefore needs to be investigated before innovation can take place. The research objectives are to define the performance of organizations' high involvement innovation (HII) in the construction industry in Russia, to analyze the correlation between HII and HR performances in order to determine the potential of organizational innovation development and promotion of employee involvement in the industry. A behavioral model questionnaire was applied to measure both the performance of organizations' HII and the average value of the construction industry. A HR performance questionnaire was developed to analyze the organizations' HR management efficiency as well as the correlation between HII and HR performances in the industry. The analysis of the collected data shows that the industry gets the 3rd position in the HII score, where HII is goal oriented. The research revealed that the HII performance depends directly on how efficient a company's HR management is, while the potential of introducing HII within the studied area is not taken full advantage of. The findings give us reasons to believe that low-level capabilities could be improved to move the firms studied to the 5th position, demonstrating a strong innovation capability with HII being the dominant culture.

articleTitle: Development of recommendations to reduce noise in toothed-belt transmissions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes series of experiments involves determining ways to reduce noise in toothed-belt gear.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of heat and moisture transfer in the system soil-adjacent ground layer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A mathematical model of no stationary moisture transfer in the binary system soil - underground layer in the type of nonlocal problem with operators of fractional differentiation for the system of equations of partial derivatives of third order is suggested. By the method of integral equations the problem of solvability of nonlocal problem was studied and found the conditions, which guarantee the uniqueness of its solution.

articleTitle: Innovative solutions of issues of import substitution and evolution of child tourism
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article focuses on the necessity of developing integrated innovative approach to solve problems of import substitution and development of domestic child tourism. Made analyzes of main problems impending development of the industry and import substitution in the sphere of child tourism, which requires integrated and comprehensive innovation approach. Proposed integrated innovative approach of import substitution and development of industry.

Author Keywords: disadvantages of the development of child tourism

articleTitle: Developing of biochemical express analyzers of blood based on computer simulation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article is devoted to the actual problem of medical equipment - the creation of a portable analyzer for monitoring blood biochemical parameters: glucose and cholesterol. A correlation analysis of the concentration of glucose and cholesterol in the blood with the parameters of arterial pressure (BP) and excess body mass index (BMI) was carried out using computer simulation. Imitative models are constructed and optimal regressions equations are obtained that ensure the calculation of glucose and cholesterol concentration with a relative error with measured levels of not more than 10-15%. A method of non-invasive of the blood test is proposed and the design of an automatic device for the rapid analysis of glucose and cholesterol in the blood is developed. The device is protected by RF patents for inventions and can be used for preliminary diagnosis, both in medical offices and at home.

articleTitle: Priorities in the provision of interstate “balance of interests” in international relations
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers public safety as the main trends in political and economic international relations that ensure inter-state “balance of interests”. Given the characteristics of its structure, place and role in the governance of the States. The authors propose the balance of priorities in solving problems in the global scale of the space in terms of development of mutually beneficial political and economic relations between States.

articleTitle: On import substitution strategy's implementation in Russian economy
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article focuses on the issue of the substitution policy's implementation in Russia. Treatments of this concept in books and papers on economics are reviewed. Measures to implement this strategy, its first results in various sectors are presented. The advantages of this strategy, prospects for further development in today's environment are assessed, and the necessity to make it export-oriented is specified.

articleTitle: Successful press service for science: Conditions and methods
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Specialists of a number of scientific institutes in this article present examples of successful models of modern press services in institutions in the field of science and education in Russia and research their key methods in work.

articleTitle: The development of regional agribusiness innovation clusters in terms of improvement of information support of investment processes in the implementation of import substitution problem
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Improving innovative-investment activity and attractiveness of the agricultural sector in the region should be based on the evidence-based results, analysis, evaluation and forecast of its competitive profile. Taking into account the existing significant differences of the economic development level between Russian regions, especially in the innovative-investment processes that lead to the breakup of economic space of the country, there is a requirement to identify priority directions of regional agriculture development.

articleTitle: Use of electromagnetic radiation for assessment of quality assembly of elements and nodes of electronic means
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper presents the results of research that can be put into the development and research of non-contact rapid method for assessing the quality of the assembly and installation of EM designs. To achieve the objectives, studied the behavior of the mechanical connection of the contact pairs, namely the definition of the contribution of R, L, C parameters contact joints in the modulation level and the spectral composition of the electromagnetic radiation mechanical contact pair.

articleTitle: Development and usage of electronic teaching technologies for the economic training of students in a technical university
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The experience of the department of the economic theory on the development and usage of technology for electronic testing and accompaniment of business games in the teaching of economic theory for students of technical stream is described.

articleTitle: Management of educational risk on the basis of data mining in GIS
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The present paper has considered scientific and methodological aspects of development of methodological, informational and instrumental support for the educational risk control system in higher educational institutions. Mathematical model, method and algorithm for estimation of educational program implementation efficiency in educational institutions have been developed. Usage of geoinformation technologies increases efficiency of control due to automation of collection, processing and analysis of data on the educational program implementation. The suggested model for estimation of the educational risk in higher institutions will allow comprehensively estimating processes occurring in departments since it takes into consideration pedagogical, economic and social aspects. Analysis of components and functions of the educational risk has been carried out. Software implementation of suggested approaches has been performed in the database control system PostgreSQL. Results of testing of the suggested technology on the basis of open data of Ryazan state radio engineering university for 2016 have been represented.

articleTitle: Incoming call user authentication by screen interaction analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article contains information about the ability to authenticate a user based on the underscore of finger movement over the touch screen. Currently, users authentication based on their individual characteristics is very popular. The article considers one of the methods of authentication based on behavioral biometrics. Using the proposed model of the application the possibility of recognizing the user the underscore of finger movement over the touch screen.

Author Keywords: finger movement over the touch screen

articleTitle: Problems of safety and modeling of dynamics of vehicles and systems on the basis of Appell's equations
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: To improve safety in transport, exact mathematical models of transport systems are required. The technique of simulation of exact differential equations of mechanical systems is considered, which makes it possible to compile mathematical models of both systems of transportable bodies and transport objects whose motion is determined and depends on wearable systems moving in a certain prescribed manner. The technique is based on Appell's equations and requires a multiple calculation of the kinetic energy and energy of the system's accelerations in a given position for different values of generalized velocities and accelerations. Computer computation of these functions is not difficult even in the study of very complex systems of solids.

Author Keywords: Technical Regulations TR of TC 018-2011 No 877

articleTitle: The quality management of technical systems' evolution
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Designing and the manufacture of competitive engineering requires the analysis of development prospects for devices created. The solution of this problem is connected to the analysis of large databases, where the information on devices of the considered class and close to it classes are stored. The application of formal methods for the information analysis promotes increase of productivity of designers' labour in early designing stages. As it is known from the evolution theory, the value of the information is determined by its use. In this connection the software made for the analysis of design databases enables to make the information use more effective and also to receive new knowledge. In the paper the analysis of an evolution of pneumatic vibration isolators with use of Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is considered. A number of the perspective technical decisions created in different moments of time was analysed on the set of quality criteria being incorporated in the hierarchy. The purpose of the analysis was formulated as follows: “To reveal the most perspective devices for perfection”. The second hierarchy level contains the following criteria groups: functional, layout, technological, economic, innovative. At the third level there are criteria connected with the appropriate functional groups. They are: vibroisolation quality, reliability, cost, operational expenses, complexity, adaptability to manufacture, patentability, competitiveness, spatial orientation, opportunity for setting-up different frequencies, compactness. The marginal analysis for criteria has revealed criteria and groups important for perfection of pneumatic vibration isolators. These criteria are: quality of a vibration damping; spatial orientation; adaptability to manufacture; opportunity for setting-up different frequencies; the complexity and the operational expenses. The most important groups for development are functional criteria, layout criteria and innovation criteria. We have considered above 500 patents of USSR on pneumatic vibration isolators. This information was processed with use of the decision-making software. In result 6 the most perspective devices created in different moments of time were chosen. The expert estimation of quality for these devices was made by a pair comparison method on quality criteria mentioned above. On the basis of calculated priorities for alternatives the following tendencies of criteria estimations changes in time are established: 1) Improvement of the vibroisolation quality. 2) Improvement of layout properties. 3) Deterioration of economic parameters. Thus the results of the marginal analysis for criteria have been completely proved at the analysis of evolution of the systems examined. The outcomes reveal criteria groups exerting the most influence on the development of systems examined, and also criteria being more important for further perfection. In this case the best prospects for development have devices with good parameters of functional properties and layout. Their perfection is connected with the improvement of economic and technological parameters.

articleTitle: Development and implementation of integrated quality management systems in Russia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper is devoted to a currently active area of scholars' research - integrated quality management systems (IQMS). Despite the high prevalence of IQMS in the US and European economies, until recently, in Russian organizations, separate management systems for each particular area were considered to be the norm: ecology, quality management of products, health and safety of personnel, etc. The reasons for the low prevalence of IQMS in small organizations in Russia are observed. We discuss such major factors as, for instance, the lack of a unified model for the formation and implementation of an IQMS at the enterprise. The methods for calculating the costs of practical implementation of IQMS, depending on the resource and organizational requirements for improving the efficiency, are not standardized. Specific measures are proposed in order to encourage the development and penetration of IQMS in Russian organizations. Attention is paid to the development of remote outsourcing organizations that build integrated quality management systems for contracting firms and allow achieving economic efficiency through economies of scale, including through the virtual integration of several small and medium-sized enterprises. The issues of developing unified schemes for the implementation of IQMS for different types of organizations, depending on the industry and other specifics, were discussed.

articleTitle: Investigation of temperatures and stresses in a polymeric instrumental composite containing a diamond with coating
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Modeling of temperature and stress fields in a diamond-coating-polymer matrix composite is carried out. The influence of coatings from sodium borosilicate glass, nickel and titanium on the temperature and stress in the system was studied. It is shown that the most effective coating is sodium borosilicate glass, which reduces the thermal load on the matrix with insignificant temperature stresses in the system.

articleTitle: Economic and legal aspects of management of innovations in the EU and the CIS
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In article the characteristic of the main tendencies and directions of realization of management of innovations in advanced industrial EU countries (Great Britain, Germany, Austria) and Japan is given. The strategy of management of innovations in the CIS countries in the system of the Euroasian integration are formulated. The concept of innovative industrial policy of the CIS countries and the Eurasian Economic Union in modern conditions of development of world economy and international law is offered.
