articleTitle: Approaches to quality assessment of applications submitted for public tenders in the automated project control systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers approaches to assessing the quality of applications submitted for participation in competitions, which are implemented in the automated project management system. These approaches allow us to evaluate the scientific background of the team of the project executors and the correspondence of the project's keywords with the selected CSCSTI codes (Codes of State Categories Scientific and Technical Information). The developed approaches are based on the use of scientometric indicators of the main results of scientific activity and the use of methods of expert assessments, the theory of mathematical statistics and information modeling. Based on the results obtained, automated rules for checking applications submitted for various competitions were implemented.

articleTitle: Subjective wellbeing of residents as an indicator of the social partnership effectiveness in urban governance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Today in Russian cities we are witnessing the transition from an elitist to a pluralistic model of urban governance. The process of city management becomes polycentric and involves the development of social partnership. One of the most important social indicators of the social partnership effectiveness in urban governance is subjective wellbeing of residents. We surveyed 3500 respondents with using stratified sampling. To analyze we applied descriptive statistics, parametric and non-parametric tests for independent samples. The analysis showed that the development of the social partnership ideology in the city management is the most important factor of the active position and civil competence of citizens in the city development-related issues.

articleTitle: Modeling of efficiency assessment for enterprises economic activity in environmental system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is dedicated to the consideration of an issue of efficiency assessment for enterprises economic activity. the analyze of scientific views of different authors to the problem of enterprises economic efficiency assessment in environmental system is done. The coefficient of environmental management quality based on Delphi technique is developed. the authors propose a new assessment indicator of ecologic and economic efficiency of enterprises activity in environmental system, also, it is tested on a particular example.

Author Keywords: indicator of ecological and economic efficiency assessment

articleTitle: Public-private partnership as a promise form of investments
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article contains the analysis of the legal framework governing PPPs in Russia, as well as the basic reasons and difficulties of interaction between the parties in the framework of PPP, in addition, to determine the prospects for PPP development in the Moscow region.

articleTitle: Instrumental means for the control and analysis of gas mixtures based on the use of artificial neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the features of creation of tools for monitoring and neuronet identification of complex gasair mixtures using devices such as “electronic nose” equipped with semiconductor gas sensitive sensors in the form of a matrix are considered. The results of experimental studies on the analysis and recognition of various gas mixtures based on the use of artificial neural networks in the processing of streaming signals from a gas sensitive matrix.

articleTitle: Experimental analysis of large prime numbers generation in residue number system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper specifies the value of evaluation of accuracy necessary for correct operation of number conversion algorithm from residue number system in weighted number system with use of the approximate method. On the basis of the approximate method the method of computation of residue number system bases extension is offered. Simulation shows that when checking large prime numbers the check algorithm functioning in RNS allows to get advantages on average for 20%.

articleTitle: Trends and social partnerships in education
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Models and main principles of cooperation between the social partners of the state, business and society in the process of educational projects realization are formulated. The ways of developing mechanisms and instruments of cooperation between social partners in the institutional environment of are offered.

articleTitle: Improving the technical and economic ffectiveness of the system of natural lighting attic space
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The mathematical model and determined the quantity of lighting on the plane of a sloping roof, from the firmament with a standard of the brightness distribution in the annual cycle for the cities of Nalchik and Moscow. According to the analysis method is developed to improve the technical and economic efficiency of an obliquely positioned light devices.

articleTitle: Manufacturing of highquality products to the method of DLP RP — Technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to manufacturing of highquality products one of the most promising methods of RP - technology. Is provided Brief description of the principle working of the method and equipment, on which was manufactured prototypes. The morphology obtained in the mode of atomic force microscopy explains the mechanism of formation of the surface layer prototypes. Also according to the results obtained using coordinate measuring machine has been set, that the deviation of the forms of mutual position of surfaces of all experienced samples manufactured by the method of DLP is reduced to a single pattern. Analysis of the results of the study gave opportunity to establish the most important factors influencing the roughness and the accuracy parameters of the samples. Based on the results of the study, we can conclude about the prospects and possibilities of application of the method DLP RP technology in the engineering industry for manufacturing high quality products.

articleTitle: Environmental impact under development of irrigation on-site irrigation system (OS)
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Problem of grain production and improvement of soil fertility are interrelated and are Central to the development of agriculture. This task can be solved only with the development of irrigation. However, irrigation development entails increasing human impact on land and water resources in areas of intensive agricultural development. When planning the use of water and land resources should be based not only in the interests of economic development of the territory, but also in equal measure to take into account the capacity of the environment.

articleTitle: Development of a mathematical model of microstructure of hail clouds by remote sensing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted the problem of developing mathematical models for determining the microstructure of hail clouds by results of measurements of radar reflectivity from the hail clouds. Determination of microstructure of hail clouds by radar characteristics is reduced to solving integral equation of Fredholm 1 kind that belongs to the class of inverse problems of scattering theory and is an ill-posed problem. Based on the method of solving ill-posed problems proposed by A. N. Tikhonov, a mathematical model and the algorithm, allowing by results of the radar reflectivity at different wavelengths, to find the distribution function of the hail particles. The results of calculation of distribution functions for three, four and five wavelengths. It is shown that the proposed mathematical model and algorithm has sufficient accuracy and stability and can serve as an effective tool for approximate solution of the problem of finding the spectrum of hail particle size measurement of radar reflectivity.

articleTitle: Management of development of teachers' continuing education in the SVE system on the basis of process approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The purpose of the paper is to examine the task of management of continuing education for the teachers in the system of secondary vocational education. The authors consider the peculiarities of teachers' continuing education development and present a unique model based on the process approach and the design of training in the form of a project which includes formal, non-formal, and informal learning. The paper demonstrates the role of internal and external recognition of learning outcomes for development of the continuing education system. The paper deals with the issues of initiation of the teachers' continuing education process. With a view to support and disseminate this process, a technique for the proactive development of vocational education organizations' project teams and an algorithm of its implementation have been developed. The algorithm is completed with guidelines for the implementation of each step of the presented technique. The paper presents the results of testing the model as well as the expert opinion regarding the impact of its implementation.

articleTitle: Development of program-algorithmic support for estimation of the influence emergencies in designing residential and industrial territories on the basis of geoinformation systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The concepts of risk and danger are considered. Methods for assessing the consequences of natural and man-made emergencies are described. The author substantiates the necessity of developing software and algorithmic support on the basis of geoinformation systems for assessing the impact of emergencies and developing management decisions.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic safety: Potential for development
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article presents the findings of a study analyzing the potential for development of technological groups and technologies for the technical and scientific area of “Electromagnetic Safety” (EMS). In this study, electromagnetic experts assessed a number of parameters for each technological group, such as the current level of development in Russia and worldwide; the potential for development by 2030 in terms of probable economic, social and technical effects; the probability of coming up with Russian world-class inventions with a large market volume by 2030; and the market demand for the products based on the inventions of technological groups by 2030. The experts assessed the significance of drivers and barriers for the development of the area in general. Based on the results, a ranking was compiled of the potential for development of EMS technological groups in Russia.

articleTitle: Mechatronics system control by criterion of minimum losses
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The optimal control laws for complex multiply connected objects are considered in the article on the example of systems of traction mechanisms by the criterion of minimum losses in the gas-air path. A mathematical model of a multiply connected object is proposed, which includes a gas-air path, an electric drive and a control system. The values of electricity consumption by electric drives of draft gears are compared for various control laws (gate valve, electric drive means, using the laws of optimal control). It is shown that due to the transition to the management of electric drive facilities and the application of optimal control laws, it is possible to reduce power consumption by approximately (20-30) %. The research was supported by RSF.

articleTitle: Evaluation the e-learning market in Russia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Rapid development of computer technology led to the formation of a whole range of information and communication technologies related to the progress of computer networks; its expansion promoted to the creation of the Internet, which allowed to change entire sectors of the economy and had a great impact on the transformation of teaching in engineering and economic education. There appeared a whole field of e-learning that ensure quality education to anyone anywhere in the world. The paper discusses the perspectives for implementation and development of e-learning in Russia. The analysis of use of electronic training by fields is made. The main systems of electronic training introduced in corporate and educational sectors of the Russian Federation are considered. A qualitative assessment of the major indicators is carried out. The evaluation of the prospects for development of the Russian platform on which MOOC format courses are located is given. A study of the Russian e-learning market on financial characteristics, the amount of students, and the quantity of higher education institutions that provide this type of service is conducted.

Author Keywords: financial indicators of the Russian e-learning market

articleTitle: Risk-based thinking of ISO 9001:2015 — The new methods, approaches and tools of risk management
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article discusses aspects of the new thinking founded on a risk-based ISO 9001:2015. It is noted that risk-based thinking is an effective tool for creating, auditing and improving quality management systems. Shows several practical examples of the implementation of the risk management process for the phase “Plan” PDCA-cycle, proposed a new model of the ISM, which contains all the basic entity for performance audits (criteria, object, audit observation) and allows to generate the level of security assessment. Additionally an approach is presented to determine the characteristics of technological devices for the healthcare industry.

articleTitle: Methodics of research of consumers psychographic characteristics in the Internet
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Authors in the paper consider such definitions as a psychography, psychographic characteristics and their correlation in classical and digital marketing. The role of psychographic characteristics in human behavior in the process of goods search and ordering in a virtual environment is defined. The authors studied the potential of social networks as the main channel for obtaining information about Internet users in conditions of limited resources. The paper analyzes the possible adaptation of the social network participant profile's, as the main channel of psychographic data on consumers, which are registered in them. The authors proposed a mechanism for interaction between the websites of companies (online stores that have a personal account of the buyer) and social networks. It based on the integration of personal data containing psychographic characteristics obtained from users. The authors conducted a quantitative research of consumer opinion, reflecting the degree of reliability of the completed questionnaire data by users of social networks in terms of psychographic characteristics. The readiness of users to fill reliably data about themselves in a social network profile that form a user's psychographic data is estimated. The degree of readiness of consumers for cooperation with Online-retailers under conditions of limited resources is studied. The paper studied the readiness of consumers with a profile in social networks, to cooperate with Online-retailers according to the mechanism of interaction proposed by the authors.

articleTitle: Digital money as a product of the development of information and telecommunication technologies
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The aim of this work is to try to propose an alternative interpretation of the essence of digital money as a product of the development of information and telecommunication technologies, and to find the criteria for its quantitative assessment. The conducted research allowed us to trace the evolution of approaches to the interpretation of digital (electronic) money, which was modified under the influence of improving information and telecommunication technologies for its transfer. As one of the methods for studying digital money, we made a choice in favor of fractal geometry. Using its tools, we were able to justify the criteria for quantifying the flow of digital money. The process of encoding information, which embodies digital money the payer transfers to the payee by sending information messages through the appropriate communication channels, turned out to be fundamental.

articleTitle: Intelligent system of knowledge control with the natural language user interface
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This electronic document is a “live” template and already defines the components of your paper [title, text, heads, etc.] in its style sheet. The paper considers the possibility and necessity of using in modern control and training systems with a natural language interface methods and mechanisms, characteristic for knowledge processing systems. This symbiosis assumes the introduction of specialized inference machines into the testing systems. For the effective operation of such an intelligent interpreter, it is necessary to “translate” the user's answers into one of the known forms of the knowledge representation, for example, into the expressions (rules) of the first-order predicate calculus. A lexical processor, performing morphological, syntactic and semantic analysis, solves this task. To simplify further work with the rules, the Skolem-transformation is used, which allows to get rid of quantifiers and to present semantic structures in the form of sequents (clauses, disjuncts). The basic principles of operation of the inference machine are described, which is the main component of the developed intellectual subsystem. To improve the performance of the machine, one of the fastest methods was chosen — a parallel method of deductive inference based on the division of clauses. The parallelism inherent in the method, and the use of the dataflow architecture, allow parallel computations in the output machine to be implemented without additional effort on the part of the programmer. All this makes it possible to reduce the time for comparing the sequences stored in the knowledge base by several times as compared to traditional inference mechanisms that implement various versions of the principle of resolutions. Formulas and features of the technique of numerical estimation of the user's answers are given. In general, the development of the human-computer dialogue capabilities in test systems, through the development of a specialized module for processing knowledge, will increase the intelligence of such systems and allow us to directly consider the semantics of sentences, more accurately determine the relevance of the user's response to standard knowledge and, ultimately, get rid of the skeptical attitude of many managers to machine testing systems.

articleTitle: Risks and threats in the processes of transport security
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper deals with the problem of ensuring the safety of vehicles and transport infrastructure. The urgency of these problems is justified and the potential threats and vulnerabilities are investigated for different types of transport. The approaches have been proposed to ensure a transport security. The method of transport security modeling is substantiated. The basic conclusions and recommendations have been formulated.

Author Keywords: potential threats and vulnerabilities for transport security

articleTitle: Information technologies of controlling as a factor of innovative development of telecommunication companies
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the specific development trends of controlling in telecommunication companies as part of implementing information technology as required in modern conditions. Conclusions are made that controlling today is in permanent development as problems of enterprise management are changing. These include “opening” the new tools. The aim of the study is to develop theoretical and methodological guidelines for using information technology as the basis for effective controlling system in telecommunication companies. The authors consider the concept of controlling, analyze the existing information technologies and software products like SAP ERP10 and “1C:ERP Enterprise Management 2”. The article demonstrates the functionality of one of them providing specific examples, which show the use of automated control systems in controlling procedures. The paper presents the authoring and proves a number of theoretical positions and methodical recommendations on forming information technology tools to improve the efficient use of controlling in telecommunication companies. The article is scientific and practical. The results of this analysis can be useful to managers and management personnel of the company, who are interested in developing the business, increasing the competitiveness of the telecommunication companies through finding new internal resources.

Author Keywords: the practical implementation of “1C:ERP Enterprise Management 2”

articleTitle: Developing the algorithm allowing business-dedicated mobile applications to read texts
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article looks at the current state of the mobile apps market and its potential to generate solutions for B2C and B2B segments. It also explores the issue of how mobile devices can be made capable of recognizing printed text containing images. Technologies are described for mobile application implementation. The article further explains how signal rank processing algorithm can be used to improve text recognition accuracy. Experimental evidence is provided of the expediency of this algorithm for use as a text recognition means on mobile devices.

articleTitle: Assessment of the impact of the modern risk-oriented standards on the security of the complex industrial facilities
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article discusses the assessment of the impact of the modern risk-based standards for ensuring the safety and security of Complex Industrial Facilities (CIF) of various industries. The focus pointed on the implementation the management systems based on PDCA cycle of safety process for CIF of fuel and energy complexes, including IT-Security. Furthermore, it is shown that the relevant applicability of modern risk-oriented standards to ensure the safety of CIF in quite different spheres of activity. This can be, for example, the application of ISO 15189:2012 for medical devices manufacturers (ISO 14971:2011) and for food industry (ISO 22000). The practical examples of the formation of a unified system of safety assessment for CIF based on the contemporary ISO standard.

articleTitle: Significance of the −2propsa index and the prostate health index in patients with prostate cancer: A literature review and data of the Russian prospective study
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The current literature review provides an analysis of fundamental studies on the -2proPSA index and prostate health index PHI and determination of their role in patients with prostate cancer. The authors revealed the basic aspects of the studied markers such as the improvement of prostate cancer detection, increase of specificity and reduction of unnecessary biopsies, identification of aggressive forms of prostate cancer, as well as the usage of the indicators to measure the progression of the disease. The results of numerous studies, including preliminary results of Russian studies on new indicators, are promising and for today allow us to recommend the use of the test to determine the values of -2proPSA Index and prostate health PHI in daily urological practice.

articleTitle: Innovative technologies secondary use of processed active source
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the ecological problems of utilization of spent activated sludge, which is a waste after biological treatment of wastewater and ways of their solution. A literature review devoted to modern methods of recycling and recycling of spent activated sludge is presented. The methods of composting of spent activated sludge, advantages and disadvantages of field composting of spent activated sludge are considered in detail. Ways of utilization of spent activated sludge in foreign countries are considered. It has been shown that, since the time of the USSR, spent activated sludge was used as a source of mineral fertilizers. The technologies of obtaining mineral fertilizers from spent activated sludge are described, their advantages and disadvantages are shown. Materials for obtaining protein-vitamin product from spent activated sludge, which can be used for feeding animals, fish and birds, have been studied. The technology of obtaining a microbial protein from spent activated sludge is described. The works in which the spent activated sludge is used for reclamation of slurry grouting are presented. The publications devoted to the production of fuel from spent activated sludge, molded into briquettes, are considered. Presented are the works of Perm scientists who developed the technology of obtaining from spent activated sludge biosorbents used for soil cleaning during oil and oil product spills. In the experimental part, physicochemical studies of the spent activated sludge from the silt areas were carried out by the authors and the gross composition of the elements was determined, which showed that the spent activated sludge is characterized by high toxicity due to the presence of heavy metal impurities. Thermal analysis was carried out, which allowed to determine the temperature range of decomposition of organic matter of spent activated sludge. Based on physical and chemical studies, a technology for neutralizing spent activated sludge was proposed. This technology includes detoxification of spent activated sludge with calcium-containing reagents, to remove toxic elements (heavy metal ions) followed by heat treatment. Thermal treatment is carried out under conditions of minimal access of oxygen to remove pathogenic microorganisms, organic contaminants and formation of active carbon. The obtained material was used as an adsorbent for cleaning oil-contaminated wastewaters and obtaining complex fertilizers that allow intensifying the processes of phytoremediation of soils from oil products.

articleTitle: Digital matrix micro forecast of informational and telecommunicational products cost value
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: An analysis of strategic directions of informational and communications modernization of the country and telecommunications development is given in the article. Informational and telecommunications products cost evaluation. Professor M.D. Kargopolov's matrix formula as a tool of innovative products micro forecast. Professor M.D. Kargopolov's matrix formula is recommended as a tool of modern economic-mathematical modeling in the digital economics for products prime cost calculation as it allows simultaneous and precise determination of informational and telecommunications products cost value.

Author Keywords: Professor M. D. Kargopolov's matrix formula

articleTitle: Model of modernization of enterprises of telecommunications industry in Russia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article examines the regression model of modernization of enterprises of the telecommunications industry of Russia, which is part of a system of three models: modernization of enterprises, innovation transformations and markets. The regression model is built on five parameters. The values of the parameters are taken from the State Program of the Russian Federation “Development of the Electronic and Telecommunications Industry for 2013–2025”. Descriptive statistics of the model are presented, the correlations between the model parameters are calculated, the results of the summary statistics of the model and regression analysis are shown with step-by-step exclusion of the model parameters, the adequacy of the model is checked. The regression equation and the equation of influence of factor variables are calculated. Conclusions are made about the greatest impact of the indicator “Labor productivity growth” on the indicator “The volume of export products” compared to other indicators, which indicates that the main direction in the State modernization program should be the increase of labor productivity in the telecommunications sector for the most effective budget investments.

articleTitle: Development of information and telecommunication technologies in the Republic of Sakha (Yakutia) in terms of the transition to a new technological mode
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article analyzes the current state of the telecommunications infrastructure of the Republic of Sakha (Yakutia). Brief description of the socio-economic situation of the republic is given, with the regional specific features of the northern territory of the Russian Federation being given. Main indicators of the influence of broadband access to the Internet on the development of the regional economy are presented. It is noted that the most popular satellite resource on the territory of the Republic of Sakha (Yakutia) is the Ku-band of the Am5 Express spacecraft. The development of communication and information technologies in the Republic of Sakha (Yakutia) will be oriented towards the transition to a new technological mode and higher rates of industrial development, which implies radical modernization of the information system and the innovative solutions in the field of information. The information infrastructure will be developed, which will ensure the competitiveness of basic and new industries, comfortable living conditions, information freedom of the population, sustainable development of the Arctic territories with the introduction of satellite communications, the modernization of postal communications and the development of electronic commerce and banking services. It is believed that the main purpose of the development of the industry of information and telecommunication technologies in the Republic of Sakha is to improve the living standards of the citizens and to boost the competitiveness of the economy on the basis of state-of-the-art information and telecommunication technologies. The basic indicators of the development of up-to-date information and telecommunication technologies up to 2030 are given. The issues of training specialists in the field of information communications within the concept of the Triple Helix model that describes the interaction between the university, business and government in the educational process are discussed. The conclusion is made that the successful development of the information and telecommunication technologies sector in the Republic of Sakha is impossible without the appropriate system of specialists' training. For the transition to the sixth technological mode, the significant modernization of the programs at all levels of education in the field of infocommunications will be required. In this regard, the introduction and implementation of the model for specialists' training within the framework of public-private partnerships and the concept of the Triple Helix theory will allow for a faster and more flexible adaptation of the system of training competitive specialists to labor market changes for enterprises and organizations of the telecommunications sector of the region's economy.

articleTitle: Management and protection of information as one of the ways to improve the performance of aviation industry enterprises
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Article is devoted to a current problem of information security. A research objective became the analysis of increase in competitiveness of the enterprises of the aviation industry due to use of information technologies and also introduction of the requirement of information security. Important aspect in realization of this approach is ensuring information security from unauthorized copying, distribution, destruction and change at all levels of the organization and to all course of life of production of the aviation industry. In article experience of application, improvement of information systems, the systems of information security at the enterprises of the aviation industry analyzed and described.

articleTitle: Improving the accuracy of virtual simulation and ensuring vibration reliability of on-board electronic equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses current issues related to the development and application of virtual simulation to ensure the reliability of the electronic equipment in the presence of vibrations on the on-board equipment of the object of its installation. The authors constructed an algorithm of the method of ensuring vibration reliability of developed structures of electronic equipment in the process of virtual simulation with receiving the vibration fields on the structures and mechanical loads on each electronic component.

articleTitle: Corporate strategy for enterprises of telecommunication services sector in Russia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The transition of the Russian telecommunications market to maturity stage brings up to date the necessity to employ a competitive strategy. Telecommunications companies provide a wide range of services in various regional markets. In this regard, they segment the market according to the types of communication services, regions and type of consumers. An analysis of telecommunications companies strategies was carried out at various phases of the market development. The following corporate strategies are found out: leadership retention, acquisition competitors' market share, market niche strategy. At the same time, the number of basic business strategies includes minimization of costs, differentiation, and focusing. In a down economy, differentiation strategy showed good sustainability. The “cost leadership” strategy of Tele2, although allowed to increase revenues, had a negative impact on the company's profitability. Within the framework of the general development strategies of the telecommunications industry, functional strategies are also formed. Among the basic functional strategies are: innovative, investment and financial.

publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article discusses the possibility of deciphering the Koban-Scythian animal style artifacts in terms of the transfer of information about the functional purpose of the object on the basis of the Circassian language. According to the materials of the archaeology and linguistics of the studied subjects and drawings with the use of the dictionary meanings of the Kabardino-Circassian language.

articleTitle: The model of ROE for the management company of the electronic industry
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference "Quality Management,Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The process of managing the financial recover of the enterprise RosElectronics is considered as an economic category, characterized by recession and post-crisis development of Russian economy. It is assumed that progressive changes in the development of electronic enterprises are determined by rates of creation and development of their strong growth and upgrade. Improvement of methodology and tools of financial recovery of electronic enterprises promotes increase in effectiveness of using limited economic resources and efficiency of their activities that allows them to perform innovative activities and provide growth of the competitiveness. As a result, the solution of considering problem is the obligatory condition for the modernization of Russian economy in the post-crisis period of its development.
